name: Material Library
description: Preset picker for AcousticMaterial. Click the strip or double-click the component to search the materials library by name and category, or choose Custom at the top; on the chart, set any band's absorption or scattering. Connect absorption or scattering (a value per octave band, 125 Hz to 8 kHz) to replace the chosen material's coefficients.

inputParameters.name: absorption
inputParameters.description: Absorption coefficients, one per octave band from 125 Hz to 8 kHz, to replace the chosen material's (optional).

inputParameters.name: scattering
inputParameters.description: Scattering coefficients, one per octave band, to replace the chosen material's (optional; a material without them is simulated with 0.05 in every band).
